_comment: Hearth's pieces that run as root, or that the system starts before you sign in, and may be updated from the Hearth Store as system parts (hearth-system-part, docs/STORE-SYSTEM-PARTS.md). Only these ids are ever installed as root-owned parts. The login screen's own screens (hearth-greeter: Hearth's greeter, its QML; the owner, Nov 26: "Yep add it") are one, on trial: hearth-login-screen uses the Store's copy only when hearth-system-part allows it, and one that doesn't show, crashes or never gets anyone signed in is left out from then on (SDDM for that start, the built-in greeter from the next). Never listed here: the boot menu, Safe start, Recovery and the units in the boot chain (they come only with Hearth OS updates, red flag 2). Decky plugins (decky: true) are here only for their test versions (red flag 13): hearth-decky puts the root-owned copy into Decky's plugins folder at Decky's next start, on trial, and a copy that doesn't load goes back to the one before by itself.
